view.scene_description: A wide-angle view inside a large warehouse with tall blue metal racks filled with stacked white crates and cardboard boxes. The floor is concrete, and fluorescent lights illuminate the space from above. A worker in a high-visibility vest is visible in the distance near pallets. The foreground shows blurred motion, suggesting movement during capture.

objects.label: blue metal rack
objects.observation: Tall blue metal shelving unit occupying left foreground, partially blurred due to motion. Holds multiple rows of white crates. Vertical posts have holes for adjustable shelves. Appears freestanding on concrete floor.

objects.label: white crates
objects.observation: Stacked white rectangular crates on the blue rack. Visible in multiple rows across the frame. Some show faint labels or markings. Occluded by rack structure and motion blur.

objects.label: worker
objects.observation: Person wearing bright yellow-green high-visibility vest, standing in background aisle. Partially obscured by racks. Appears to be handling materials near pallets. Unclear if stationary or moving.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Yellowish-brown cardboard boxes stacked on upper levels of right-side rack. Some have visible labels. Located behind blue rack structure. Not fully occluded but partially hidden by adjacent racks.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray concrete surface covering entire ground area. Shows some scattered debris and faint tire marks. Extends from foreground to background. Supports all racks and equipment.

objects.label: fluorescent lighting
objects.observation: Bright overhead lights mounted on ceiling beams. Provide even illumination across warehouse. Visible as glowing panels above racks. No direct contact with objects below.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s2-34451", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
